label: Thermometer
author: Conky-Studio
description: Vertical thermometer: bulb + stem fill mapped from Min→Max. Optional heat-map colour on the mercury.
lua_draw_body:
local cx, ty, H, sw, br = {x}, {y}, {height}, {stem_width}, {bulb_radius}
 local min_v, max_v = {min_value}, {max_value}
 local span = max_v - min_v; if span == 0 then span = 1 end
 local val = tonumber({value}) or min_v
 local pct = (val - min_v) / span; if pct < 0 then pct = 0 elseif pct > 1 then pct = 1 end
 local tr, tg, tb = {track_color}
 local cr_, cg, cb = {color}
 -- glass stem
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tr, tg, tb, {opacity} * 0.85)
 cairo_rectangle(cr, cx - sw/2, ty, sw, H)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 -- glass bulb
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, ty + H + br * 0.55, br, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 -- mercury
 local fill_h = H * pct
 if {heat_map} and studio_heat_rgb then
  cr_, cg, cb = studio_heat_rgb(pct)
 end
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, cr_, cg, cb, {opacity})
 cairo_rectangle(cr, cx - sw/2 + 1, ty + H - fill_h, sw - 2, fill_h)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, ty + H + br * 0.55, br - 2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
